{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Light blue wool blend structured blazer, tailored fit, elbow length, #A2B5E0.
Cream silk blouse, relaxed collar, hip length, ivory.
Dark grey wool crepe trousers, straight leg, ankle length, charcoal grey.
Tan leather loafers, classic almond toe, medium heel height, smooth finish.
Silver geometric stud earrings and a thin gold chain necklace.

This outfit works perfectly for a morning office setting during autumn by layering a structured blazer over a soft silk blouse to provide warmth against possible rain while maintaining a polished look. The dark grey wool trousers offer durability and comfort for walking throughout the day, while the neutral tones of cream and tan keep the ensemble versatile and professional. Finished with sleek loafers and subtle silver jewelry, the complete ensemble meets the "neat" dress code requirements without feeling overly rigid or formal."}
